t: The Site Heyward women's work trousers offer practical and durable workwear for various trades. These black work trousers feature a regular fit, mid-rise waist, and a straight leg design, providing comfort and mobility throughout the workday. Ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general construction workers, they include a multi-pocket design with 2 front hip, 1 thigh, 1 phone, 2 back, and 2 toploading knee pad pockets for essential tool and accessory storage. Constructed from a hard-wearing 65% polyester and 35% cotton blend with double stitched seams and a reliable YKK zip fly, these trousers are also machine washable for easy care and include a convenient hammer strap.
b: 2 x Front Hip, 1 x Thigh, 1 x Phone, 2 x Back & 2 x Knee Pad Pockets
